name: 11788 · Hauppauge, NY
findings: ZIP 11788 (Hauppauge) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11788 (Hauppauge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
